name: Manufacturing for Product Innovation
description: Machining: turning, milling, grinding, shaping, gear manufacturing. Welding: gas-metal arc welding, gas welding, TIG, MIG, RSW, laser welding, robotic MIG welding. Casting and forging: sand casting, die casting, investment casting, centrifugal casting, and forging. Precision manufacturing: wire-cut EDM, die sinking EDM, abrasive water jet, laser cutting, micromachining and super finishing. Digital manufacturing: 3D printing, CNC turning and milling, collaborative manufacturing through cobot, schematic design, PCB manufacturing and electronics assembly, AR/VR and IoT. Sheet metal, fabrication, woodworking and composite manufacturing: sheet metal bending, shearing, forming, swaging, and seam making; cutting, sawing, filling, and fabrication using power tools; woodworking; composite manufacturing. Design and product realization.
